title: Coercion aur truthy/falsy predict karo
starterCode:
// Pehle har line ka output predict karo, phir run karo:
console.log("5" + 1)          // ?
console.log("5" - 1)          // ?
console.log(true + 1)         // ?
console.log(null + 1)         // ?
console.log(undefined + 1)    // ?
console.log("5" + null)       // ?

// Truthy ya falsy?
console.log(Boolean("0"))     // ?
console.log(Boolean([]))       // ?
console.log(Boolean({}))       // ?
console.log(Boolean(0))        // ?
console.log(Boolean("false")) // ?
solution:
console.log("5" + 1)       // "51" (string concat)
console.log("5" - 1)       // 4 (string → number)
console.log(true + 1)      // 2
console.log(null + 1)      // 1 (null → 0)
console.log(undefined + 1) // NaN
console.log("5" + null)    // "5null"
console.log(Boolean("0"))     // true
console.log(Boolean([]))       // true
console.log(Boolean({}))       // true
console.log(Boolean(0))        // false
console.log(Boolean("false")) // true
hints: + string ke saath concat karta hai, - subtract karta hai
